text:
Liam Ohgren has been one of the few bright spots in Vancouver's slide. The 22-year-old Swede, a 2022 first-round pick of Minnesota, scored four goals in five games around the start of November, and on a night Manny Malhotra called out the team's "lack of effort" after a loss in Winnipeg, Pass it to Bulis's Daniel Wagner wrote "at least Liam Öhgren was good".

He has 6 goals and 9 points in 19 games. Our read is that it is mostly bounces for now: 6 goals on 3.0 expected, shooting 23% after 9% last season, and his own chances over his last ten games are normal for him. The odd part is his ice time, down 2:37 a night over that stretch even as the goals came. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 53% of his shots coming off the rush, and his shot is in the 87th percentile for speed. At five on five Vancouver is a touch worse with him on, so the step forward he needs is in creating chances, not finishing them.
headline: Liam Ohgren's goals arrive, minutes do not
